book.title: Frankenstein · Chapter 3 — The Day That Decided My Fate
book.author: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1818), Chapter 3

cast.name: Victor

cast.anchor: a young man with round glasses and intense eyes

cast.name: Elizabeth
cast.canonical: a gentle young woman with bright fair GOLDEN hair in a long braid
cast.anchor: bright fair golden hair in a long braid

cast.name: Caroline

cast.anchor: dark hair in a centre-parted bun, a cross necklace and a high-collar dark dress

cast.anchor: a neat grey beard and a long dark coat (dignified, slender)

cast.anchor: a small top hat and a travel scarf

cast.anchor: a curly powdered wig, squat build and a jabbing finger

cast.anchor: a bald head with half-moon spectacles and a scholar's gown

panels.scene: a lean bespectacled young man and his slender bearded father discussing over papers in a Geneva study, a travelling trunk half-packed

teen.narration: AT SEVENTEEN, VICTOR IS TO LEAVE FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF INGOLSTADT.

bubbles.text: When I had attained the age of seventeen my parents resolved that I should become a student at the university of Ingolstadt.
the first misfortune of my life occurred-an omen, as it were, of my future misery

panels.scene: a woman with a bun tenderly nursing a fevered golden-haired girl in a sickbed, cool cloths and medicine

teen.narration: BUT FIRST, TRAGEDY: ELIZABETH FALLS ILL WITH SCARLET FEVER, AND CAROLINE INSISTS ON NURSING HER.

bubbles.text: when she heard that the life of her favourite was menaced, she could no longer control her anxiety. She attended her sickbed
her illness was severe, and she was in the greatest danger

panels.scene: the golden-haired girl recovering and sitting up, while the bun-haired mother now sways, pale and feverish herself

teen.narration: ELIZABETH IS SAVED — BUT AT A TERRIBLE PRICE.

bubbles.text: Elizabeth was saved, but the consequences of this imprudence were fatal to her preserver.

panels.scene: a tender candlelit deathbed: three hands clasped together upon a white bedcover in the foreground center, a woman with a cross necklace uniting a golden-haired young woman's hand with another's, bowed heads in solemn grief, the dying mother among them, quiet mourning chamber
panels.composition: wide deathbed, three figures, tender and grave

teen.narration: ON HER DEATHBED, CAROLINE JOINS VICTOR’S AND ELIZABETH’S HANDS — HER LAST WISH.

bubbles.speaker: caroline
bubbles.text: My children... my firmest hopes of future happiness were placed on the prospect of your union. This expectation will now be the consolation of your father. Elizabeth, my love, you must supply my place to my younger children.

panels.scene: the mother lying peacefully still, a serene expression, the family bowed in grief around the bed

bubbles.text: She died calmly, and her countenance expressed affection even in death.

panels.scene: an empty chair and a shrouded portrait in a darkened house of mourning, a heavy stillness
panels.composition: medium still-life of grief, no figures

teen.narration: THE HOUSE FILLS WITH THE UNBEARABLE EMPTINESS OF LOSS.

bubbles.text: It is so long before the mind can persuade itself that she whom we saw every day and whose very existence appeared a part of our own can have departed for ever

panels.scene: the golden-haired young woman gently comforting the grieving family, veiling her own sorrow with a brave warm smile

teen.narration: ELIZABETH HIDES HER OWN GRIEF TO COMFORT THEM ALL.

bubbles.text: She indeed veiled her grief and strove to act the comforter to us all.

panels.scene: two young men clasping hands in a lamplit farewell, one in a small top hat and scarf, both moved

teen.narration: CLERVAL — FORBIDDEN BY HIS FATHER TO JOIN — SAYS A HARD GOODBYE.

bubbles.text: We could not tear ourselves away from each other nor persuade ourselves to say the word

panels.scene: a bespectacled young man alone in a horse chaise on an open road, gazing back, melancholy

teen.narration: FOR THE FIRST TIME IN HIS LIFE, VICTOR IS TRULY ALONE.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: I was now alone.

panels.scene: a bespectacled young traveller arriving before a town crowned by a tall high white steeple

bubbles.text: the high white steeple of the town met my eyes

panels.scene: a squat scowling professor in a powdered wig jabbing a finger scornfully at the young man, dismissing his old books

teen.narration: PROFESSOR KREMPE MOCKS THE ALCHEMISTS VICTOR LOVED.

bubbles.speaker: krempe
bubbles.text: every instant that you have wasted on those books is utterly and entirely lost. You have burdened your memory with exploded systems and useless names.
Good God! In what desert land have you lived, where no one was kind enough to inform you that these fancies which you have so greedily imbibed are a thousand years old
every instant that you have wasted on those books is utterly and entirely lost. You have burdened your memory with exploded systems and useless names

panels.scene: a close unflattering portrait of the short squat gruff professor in his powdered wig, repellent and pompous

teen.narration: VICTOR IS NOT WON OVER — KREMPE IS TOO GRUFF AND REPELLENT.

bubbles.text: M. Krempe was a little squat man with a gruff voice and a repulsive countenance

panels.scene: a benevolent short erect bald professor with half-moon spectacles and a gown beginning a lecture at a podium, warm and dignified

teen.narration: THEN HE HEARS WALDMAN LECTURE ON CHEMISTRY — SO UNLIKE KREMPE.

bubbles.text: his voice the sweetest I had ever heard
This professor was very unlike his colleague

panels.scene: the bald spectacled professor speaking with fervour, sweeping his hand toward glowing images of stars, lightning and the human heart

teen.narration: AND WALDMAN’S WORDS STRIKE VICTOR LIKE LIGHTNING.

bubbles.speaker: waldman
bubbles.text: these philosophers, whose hands seem only made to dabble in dirt, and their eyes to pore over the microscope or crucible, have indeed performed miracles. They penetrate into the recesses of nature and show how she works in her hiding-places. They ascend into the heavens; they have discovered how the blood circulates, and the nature of the air we breathe. They have acquired new and almost unlimited powers; they can command the thunders of heaven, mimic the earthquake, and even mock the invisible world with its own shadows.

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man alight with feverish ambition, eyes blazing, a storm of ideas around his head

teen.narration: SOMETHING IGNITES IN HIM — A HUNGER TO GO FURTHER THAN ANYONE.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: So much has been done... more, far more, will I achieve... I will pioneer a new way, explore unknown powers, and unfold to the world the deepest mysteries of creation.
Such were the professor's words-rather let me say such the words of the fate-enounced to destroy me
So much has been done, exclaimed the soul of Frankenstein-more, far more, will I achieve

panels.scene: the kindly bald professor showing the eager young man his laboratory of gleaming instruments, a fateful handshake

teen.narration: WALDMAN TAKES HIM ON AS A DISCIPLE AND OPENS HIS LABORATORY. THE ROAD TO THE CREATURE HAS BEGUN.

bubbles.text: Thus ended a day memorable to me; it decided my future destiny.
Thus ended a day memorable to me; it decided my future destiny
I closed not my eyes that night. My internal being was in a state of insurrection and turmoil
